## Summary

- Replace unstyled `<AbsoluteFill>` wrappers with React fragments in documentation and skill examples.
- Remove unused imports while preserving examples where `<AbsoluteFill>` provides layout, styling, or timing.

## Validation

- PR workflow build and stylecheck passed.
- Docs twoslash prewarm checked 1,677 snippets with no errors.
- Docusaurus production build and generated JavaScript validation passed.
